import bpy
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
ms=[o for o in sc.objects if o.type=='MESH']
pts=[o.matrix_world @ Vector(c) for o in ms for c in o.bound_box]
lo=Vector((min(p.x for p in pts),min(p.y for p in pts),min(p.z for p in pts)))
hi=Vector((max(p.x for p in pts),max(p.y for p in pts),max(p.z for p in pts)))
ctr=(lo+hi)/2
cam=bpy.data.objects['mcp_cam']
cam.location=ctr+Vector((0.6,-1.0,1.1))*max((hi-lo).x,(hi-lo).y)
cam.rotation_euler=(ctr-cam.location).to_track_quat('-Z','Y').to_euler()
sun=bpy.data.objects.new('mcp_sun', bpy.data.lights.new('mcp_sun','SUN'))
sun.data.energy=3; sun.rotation_euler=(0.6,0.2,0.4)
sc.collection.objects.link(sun)
sc.world=sc.world or bpy.data.worlds.new('w'); sc.world.color=(0.6,0.6,0.65)
result={'lo':list(lo),'hi':list(hi),'lights':sum(o.type=='LIGHT' for o in sc.objects)}
